Free with conditions

Riksdagshuset

Riksgatan 3

Public tours are free, with 28 spaces per tour. This is not unrestricted access at any time.

Booking and admission

Public tours cannot be booked in advance; arrive early for security screening. Groups of 10–35 must book a tour ahead.

Outdoor walks and photography

Monteliusvägen, Gamla stan and Djurgården: walking in public spaces requires no museum ticket. Buildings, attractions and organised tours may charge admission. Check access conditions and weather.
